opening.argument: The speaker explains how DeFi rebase-token projects work, including bonds, staking, and the redistribution of tokens to holders. He discusses a stated APY and his own OHM and Spartacus purchases, but also describes a scenario in which the token falls 90% despite passive rewards. He calls Spartacus risky and urges viewers to do their own research. Those cautions matter: the displayed yields are discussed as project claims within market analysis, not as verified returns or guaranteed payments. The record supports a discussion of speculative investments, with their downside left plainly in view.
